category: hosted feature flags, A/B testing and product analytics

free_tier.stated: Starter: free with no credit card; up to 3 users and 1 project, unlimited feature flags, experiments and traffic; 1M CDN requests and 5 GB CDN bandwidth a month; managed warehouse 1M events a month
free_tier.notes: The plan is counted in seats (one login each), CDN requests, CDN gigabytes and warehouse events; no single unit term fits. End-user traffic is not counted. The CDN figures are soft guidelines: an outlier is notified and the UI shows a CDN usage exceeded warning. SSO on Starter is Google only and roles are admin only; sequential testing, CUPED and multi-arm bandits are not on Starter.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no feature or payload size limit is stated on the pages read

retention.stated: unverified: no retention period for managed-warehouse events or audit history is stated on the pages read

egress.terms: CDN delivery of flag payloads: 1M requests and 5 GB of bandwidth a month on Starter as soft guidelines; paid overage is USD 10 per additional million CDN requests and USD 1 per additional…
egress.free_allowance: 1M CDN requests and 5 GB of CDN bandwidth a month

interface_detail: REST API at https://api.growthbook.io/api with a Secret Key or Personal Access Token over HTTP Basic or Bearer auth, 60 requests per minute (a GET /api/v1/features without a key answered 400 Missing Authorization header); an MCP server.
tooling: 24+ SDKs, the setup wizard (npx @growthbook/wizard), an MCP server, or any HTTP client against the REST API.
chaining: Flags and experiments for apps on free compute, analysed in a warehouse the user already has or in the managed warehouse at 1M events a month.

limits.value: 1M CDN requests and 5 GB CDN bandwidth a month (soft guideline)

limits_note: 3 users and 1 project on Starter; the vocabulary has no kind for a seat count.
binding_note: Flag payloads are served from the CDN, so 1M CDN requests a month is the first ceiling for an app with traffic; it is enforced by notice, not a hard stop.

identity_cost.detail: The pricing page states no credit card is required and that every user needs an own login and password. The Cloud register form at app.growthbook.io renders only in a browser and could not be read, so its fields are unverified.

reliability_note: Usage above the CDN guidelines triggers a notice and a CDN usage exceeded warning in the UI rather than a stop.
confidence_note: The REST API host was probed and answered 400 Missing Authorization header without a key. The identity kind rests on the login-and-password sentence, because the register form could not be rendered.
